main_text.l: craftino crapulæ memineris hefternæ. Vos olim,
ô Romani libertatem fecistis bello, vos etiam pacis,
estote discipuli, annunciantibus vobis Persis, vt la-
chrymosum bellum excutiatis. Qui enim primò
peccant, illos etiam correctionis decet pœnite-
ntia. Ne putetis confidentiam esse hanc meam tam
humanam orationem. Cum enim nullius indi-
geat Persarum rex, heri forte vel nudius tertius,
quando suam terram ausus est calcare Romanus
exercitus, prælio congredi renuit. Auro enim
multo, donisque lautis emere Romanos pacem
iubet, nec sane pro pœna bellum imponere pec-
cantibus fas est: quia multa pecuniaria & Pers-
i-cum animum placare, & ferociâ Romanorum bel-
lica expletam tuba, non nequit comprimere. Cùm
orationem adhuc extenderet legatus adversa o-
m-nium contra cum exsibilantium tollebantur su-
fragia, clamore insuper ingenti, quasi graviter se-
rentium orationem barbari. Elatis enim videban-
tur esse animis, propter illas quas primum ex-
perti fuerant res prosperas, quum & Persarum di-
sturbarunt ordines, & prædis spoliisq; potiti Car-
darigam circumuenerunt. Dimissâ verò ab Im-
peratore concione, Persa dicendi finem fecit: nec
multis post diebus Nisibidis antistes honore sa-
cerdotali præfulgens, ad ducem abiit, eademque
Metodis verba in medium proponit: quæ cum dux
per tabellarium ad regem scripsisset, agnito
Imperatoris sigillo ducis edicto, statim facto, Philippi-
cum iussit impurissimas has inducias thissum fa-
cere, tanquam obstante Romana magnanimi-
tate. Duxigitur Imperatoris tabellis conuolutis,
propè

page.notes: Top line begins with a damaged first letter ("eraftino"), read as "craftino" with uncertainty; the word itself may be a printing error for "crastino". Page number read as 58 but uncertain. Long s has been normalised to plain s throughout, and u/v and i/j regularised. Doubtful readings: "Duxigitur" (possibly printer's error), "Cardarigam", "Metodis", "thissum", "Nisibidis", "Philippi-cum" and several words at line ends in the lower half. Left margin fragments are cropped at the scan edge and cannot be read, so they are omitted. Right-edge marks are show-through and are omitted. Paragraph breaks: no indented line appears, so the page is one continuous paragraph.
